evidence.release: 33f2ca1d deployed to production; CI 40228310355, Worker migration/deploy 40228310408, and Web deploy 40228310357 succeeded.
evidence.verified: Harness assignment stop persists cancelled state, signals only the matching workspace/assignment/generation in AgentRunner, aborts in-flight supported model/tool requests, prevents further model/tool rounds and suppresses late replies. Personal-DM Agent tool cancellation now cancels its queued/running Mac mini JavaScript or published app-action job, invalidating the lease so the gateway heartbeat stops the isolated VM; a focused Worker integration test verifies both job types and the stale lease rejection. External Claude Managed Agent runs receive an exact-session user.interrupt; Cursor Cloud Agent runs receive the documented run cancel endpoint. Provider stop outcomes are persisted on the assignment and exposed in refreshed UI state with retry for uncertain failures. Earlier exact-SHA CI passed all nine workflow jobs. Production Worker /health returned ok=true and encryption.all=true; the migration/deploy workflow succeeded. Production Web asset assets/index-CwQcy37i.js (1,057,623 bytes; SHA-256 75636a0078e529515b13f0c3223756226c89b7b05e290fa7f0e87ef7b12a240a) matched a local build byte-for-byte with VITE_API_HOST=tiktokforwork.torubj0904.workers.dev. The signed-in Honmaru app reloaded, and its existing synthetic run status panel rendered. No live external provider cancellation was triggered.
evidence.remaining: This follow-up is a local candidate and is not yet production-released. Devin/Codex adapters do not expose implemented cancellation here. Other signal-insensitive tools may finish an in-flight side effect. Provider-side billing for an interrupted request may be unknown; live external cancellation and confirmation of its provider-side terminal state remain unverified. This is partial parity, not a 100% clone.
